name: loongs/language
description: loong-swoole i18n: translator with language packs (php / json, several directories, later ones override), Accept-Language negotiation with q-values and fallback chains (en-US → en → zh-CN), {name} placeholders, simple pluralization, missing-key reporting and a per-coroutine current locale (Swoole-safe); optional loongs/framework middleware and loongs/render adapter

suggest.ext-swoole: Per-coroutine current locale (LocaleContext); without Swoole a process-local slot is used (CLI / FPM)
suggest.loongs/framework: Integration\Framework\LocaleMiddleware: negotiate the request locale (query / Accept-Language), Content-Language + Vary headers

scripts.test: php -d disable_functions= tests/language_test.php cli && php -d disable_functions= tests/language_test.php co
